purpose: Heterogeneous downlink feeder interference management and AI dynamic-computation acceleration
frequency_overlap_policy: interval_intersection; per-GSO frequency masks from screening snapshot
ngso_tx_power_convention: fixed total power per active 100MHz carrier; no power scaling for subsequent bandwidth variants without an explicit policy
lf_threshold_status: paper-derived experimental criterion; not a universal regulatory threshold
gso_association_policy: 12 fixed one-to-one reference associations; no handover
coordination_assumption: ideal centralized cross-operator frequency coordination; not evidence of real operator coordination

antenna_patterns.ngso_tx: ITU-R S.1528 reference family; exact revision/formula must be pinned before RF execution
antenna_patterns.gso_rx: reference pattern and applicable regulatory antenna class pending

parameter_provenance: 12dBW/35dBi/45.76dBi/398K/40deg/-12.2dB are controlled paper-reference assumptions, not operator measurements
gso_parameters: per-station assumptions in frozen metadata; 3.5m/0.65 efficiency/398K/10deg
orbit_policy: frozen raw catalogue candidates; operational/altitude filtering is deferred and must create a derived version with a selection manifest
metrics: NGSO LF overall and by constellation
change_policy: No overwrite of v1; changes require v2 or a named derived experiment
